structured.answer: I'd pick B, the one in rows ("ב. אותו סיפור בשורות"): the words and the amount sit together on the right where I start reading, so I can go down line by line. In A the names are at the bottom and the amounts at the top and my eyes keep jumping. What I took away is that if you take the money out before 6 years the tax takes a piece (that red "−13,974 ₪"), and if you wait it takes "0 ₪".

stuck.why: It's full of English letters (S&P500, 4D), "מדד" used in a way I don't know, management-fee percentages and fund numbers. I nearly decided the page wasn't for me.
The amounts are at the top and the names at the bottom, so I had to go up and down to match them. The dark brown blocks inside the columns didn't tell me anything.
A minus in red. It frightened me, and it took me a while to understand it's tax that only applies if you withdraw before 6 years.

stuck.where: Screen 3, the same chart for year 6
stuck.why: At first I thought it was the same picture again. Only the numbers changed, and the year 6 circle is small.
